uncheckedStatements: Where a saved state records it, placement was compared on each object's saved start and end points, placement origin, plane and position within 0.5 mm along each axis (so any move of more than 1 mm is reported), and on its saved orientation within about 0.2°. A plate's outline and a bolt group's bolt pattern are compared exactly. Tekla's own position settings (on plane, rotation, at depth) are compared only through where they put the object. A saved state read before FloLess recorded placement has none; its objects without a bounding box are listed as not checked.
Cuts, fittings and bolt groups were compared as objects of their own, on their position, plane, outline or bolt pattern. The solid shape a cut or hole leaves in a part was not measured.
Welds were compared on their size and type; a weld that was not drawn has no position to compare.
Part and assembly position marks were not compared.
Points (reference points) are not tracked by Tekla’s save history, so the history cross-check does not cover them.
